newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD TALKS WITH ASIAN INVESTORS-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD TALKS WITH ASIAN INVESTORS-REPORT.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, a privatised company expected soon on the stock exchange, is in talks with Asian investors on investment that may allow it to build more ships than it repairs, newspaper Diena said on Tuesday.
Board chairman Erik Kazha told the newspaper the firm was currently in talks with Asian investors.
"If these talks are succesful and we receive investment we will start building large ships," he told the daily.
Riga Shipyard needs some $10 million of investment in technology and machinery to do this, he added.
This autumn the company will complete a fishing trawler ordered in Norway, Kazha was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
Riga Shipyard is expected to get its bourse listing in early May and has expressed its desire to join the main official list.
